purpose: Detection rate of cfar-v1 and cfar-v2 (the candidates of the open-sea monitor, ocean-monitor-1) measured against AIS south of Hong Kong (area HKS of ocean/monitor.json), for the confidence shown on open-sea candidates elsewhere.

files.summary.json: totals: detection rate per detector (v1, v2), match radius (200, 300 m) and AIS length band, with n (reference ships) and a 95 % Wilson interval; length-difference quantiles; counts of candidates by AIS match
files.passes.json: one record per Sentinel-1 pass: counts only
files.candidates/YYYY-MM-DD.json: per candidate of the monitor (join on acquired_utc + lon + lat): AIS matched / unmatched / no_ais_coverage at 200 and 300 m and the length band (ge100, 50_100, lt50) of the longest AIS ship within 300 m

method.ais_source: aisstream.io terrestrial AIS, received for +-20 minutes around each pass, inside the HKS box only
method.time: imaging time of each point from the product's start/end and footprint (linear along the track)
method.extrapolation: last report within 2 min (moving) or 10 min (SOG < 0.5 kn) extrapolated with SOG/COG to the imaging time
method.azimuth_shift: a moving ship appears displaced along the heading by -(R/V)*v_away (R/V = 120 s; 107-133 s over the swath; v_away = velocity along the right-looking direction, positive away); the AIS position is moved by it before matching
method.reference_ships: AIS ships with a known length inside the cells the monitor saw (state seen), not within 1 km of the coast or 300 m of a fixed object of OSM (osm/HKS.json, approximate)

detectors.v1: all published candidates (cfar-v1 medium/high, length estimate >= 80 m; v1 low and the coast band, fixed objects and sea-state exclusions are not published, so they cannot hit)
detectors.v2: published candidates with v2_match (a cfar-v2 detection within 100 m)

method.match: a ship is a hit when at least one candidate of the detector lies within the radius (not one-to-one)
method.candidate_status: matched = an AIS ship within the radius; unmatched = none, but an AIS report within 10 km (inside AIS coverage); no_ais_coverage = no AIS report within 10 km

limits: Terrestrial AIS only: ships far from the receivers (offshore) are missing, so the rate is for ships near the coast of Hong Kong and the Pearl River estuary, and 'unmatched' is not 'dark'.
A hit does not prove the candidate is that ship (a 40 m pixel, 200-300 m radius, busy waters).
Ships with no static data in the window have no length and are not in n.
The v1 length estimate is limited to >= 80 m, so the 50-100 m band is expected to be low by design.
rules: No AIS position, MMSI, name or call sign is published or committed; ship counts and rates only.
Per-candidate flags are published for the monitor's own candidates (already public); nothing is published for ships that were not detected.
attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [2026]. AIS: aisstream.io (reception results only: counts, rates and per-candidate match flags; no AIS ship position or identity is published).
